description: The hunts become stranger and more personal as cursed idols, prophecies, missing expeditions and family connections send Sydney and Nigel from Africa and India to China, Europe and the Americas, often with rivals or governments chasing the same object.

s02e01.description: A cursed African idol is aging its thief at terrifying speed, and Sydney must return it before the punishment becomes irreversible.

s02e02.description: A sacrificial dagger linked to Kali has driven a scholar to murder, forcing Sydney to return the weapon to its ancient sheath in India.

s02e03.description: The search for a Mochica relic of protection turns into a rescue when Nigel and his companions are captured by guerrillas in South America.

s02e04.description: Sydney and Nigel enter Africa to test a legend about a vanished civilization and discover whether its traces survived.

s02e05.description: Sydney reunites with an old high-school love while tracking a Hawaiian fertility idol that has surfaced in Madagascar.

s02e06.description: A deck of rare tarot cards left by a dead friend becomes the first piece in Sydney's search for a hidden Romani crown.

s02e07.description: Sydney's father asks her to save the Jade Empress before construction of a Chinese dam floods the valley hiding it.

s02e08.description: With Sydney and Nigel away, Claudia joins a hunt for Caesar's supposedly impenetrable armor and discovers relic hunting is less glamorous up close.

s02e09.description: Two missing graduate students lead Sydney and Nigel into the Louisiana bayou on the trail of the Haitian Cross of Utu.

s02e10.description: Sydney and Nigel parachute into the Myanmar jungle with a billionaire to find a missing expedition searching for an ancient sacrificial bowl.

s02e11.description: While consulting on an adventure film, Sydney and Nigel realize the production's pharaonic props may actually be authentic long-lost royal relics.

s02e12.description: Sydney is kidnapped, leaving Nigel, Claudia and Cate to sift through the long list of enemies she has made as a relic hunter.

s02e13.description: An Egyptian exhibition triggers Claudia's apparent memories of a past life as Cleopatra's servant and points toward a relic from that era.

s02e14.description: Sydney helps a student seek his ancestors' fabled Eyes of Toklamanee while armed pursuers close in on the same Mississippi Valley secret.

s02e15.description: After an ambush in Russia, Sydney wakes in a stranger's home with a gap in her memory and doubts about the man claiming to have saved her.

s02e16.description: MI5 interrupts Sydney's European lecture tour with a Nostradamus prophecy that may identify her as the only person able to prevent an assassination.

s02e17.description: A friend's discovery revives the trail of the Golden Hawk of Maribor, lost since the early eighteenth century.

s02e18.description: Sydney and Nigel use a newly discovered crystal and stone tablet to locate Gunther's Scepter, sealed away since the fall of ancient Germania.

s02e19.description: A cursed executioner's mask disfigures a model, leaving Sydney to find the tomb that may be the only way to break the curse.

s02e20.description: A British Museum search for Henry VIII's lost ring brings Nigel into uncomfortable competition with his confident older brother Preston.

s02e21.description: A Hungarian monastery hides the truth behind a petrified demon and the weapon that once defeated it, but its abbot refuses Sydney and Nigel entry.

s02e22.description: A dying man has twelve hours to deliver the lethal Tau Cross to a blackmailer, forcing Sydney into a race for both the relic and the antidote.
